#TheBondservantofChristJohn
#HopeGivingTestimonies

Testimony👇

A DECEMBER OF ASCENSIONS!

Perfect day Sons of God!
My name is St Alvin from the Philippines.
I just wanted to share my two-week experience from visiting Spirit Revelation Ecclesia for the 2025 Roar for All Nations, Water Baptism, and Ascension Prayers.

Before coming here, I had several dreams with Papa John. In one dream, he taught on how to break the monitoring spirits of my family. I saw 2 drones flying above me that Papa John told me to grab and break, so I grabbed and broke them into pieces.

From then on, I noticed significant changes of hunger for more prayer, fasting and consecration.

My 2nd dream was when Papa John appeared to me at the back of the auditorium after his ministration. I was excited to come close, but I noticed that everything that came close to him burned like chaff. I was afraid but he grabbed me and in a second, I screamed.

That’s when I decided to come and visit SRE, and this time by the grace of God I convinced my wife to come along.
Though there were some struggles in the visa processing because of some conflicts of having advance bookings in Japan tour, the travel agency managed to expedite our visa processing. Praise God to that!

Afterwards, we packed our things and flew heading to Cape Town. It was jam-packed with services of SRE, I had nothing to lose but was filled with a great expectation.
At the hotel I stayed, I again had several dreams that the man of God blew air inside me. I heard my two ears puff with air; it was such a great relief receiving a breath that I believe was an impartation of life and fire.

Come Sunday worship, it was the last Anointing Sunday service of 2025, we received the oil and afterwards went to Camps Bay for water baptism. I remember that after the immersion, my voice cracked, and an intense experience came upon my body, then I began to speak in tongues.
On Thursday, during the scheduled prayer at SRE I had a terrific experience of groaning and roaring at the altar, offering petition for my family, relatives, friends, churchmates and our nation Philippines as well.

Furthermore, the Friday ascension prayer marked my prayer breakthrough that I soared high in roaring and groanings until my voice cracked.

Glory be to Jesus the Christ, I received the fresh fire of the Holy Spirit through the Bondservant of Christ, John Anosike. Thanks also for Mama Ola for her wholehearted devotion and financial guidance and to all the Mini-Ministers of the Anosike family. My life changed and it will never be the same. Hallelujah!

I encourage everyone to come and experience the fresh fire of the Holy Spirit and join and be a Partner in this new move of God and receive the blessings and graces of the Father in Jesus Christ name, Amen.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY
In view of A.R. Rahman – “Harmony of Hearts” event at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium on 20.12.2025 (Saturday), traffic movement is expected to remain regulated/slow from 12:00 Noon to 11:00 PM.
📍 AFFECTED ROUTES (12:00 Noon – 11:00 PM):
IP Marg (MGM Road), Vikas Marg, Ring Road (Rajghat to IP Depot)
📍 DIVERSION / RESTRICTIONS (As Required):
Heavy vehicles restricted from Rajghat to IP Marg
Diversions may be imposed on IP Marg / Vikas Marg
📍 PARKING ADVISORY:
No parking on Ring Road (Rajghat to IP Flyover) on both carriageways.
Unauthorised vehicles will be towed and prosecuted as per law.
📍 ENTRY ADVISORY (For Event Attendees):
Gates 07 & 08 → Entry from Velodrome Road
Gates 16, 18, 21, 22 & 23 → Entry from MGM Road
📍 COMMUTER ADVISORY:
Plan your travel in advance.
Use alternate routes & public transport.
Follow traffic diversions and instructions of traffic staff.
#DTPUpdates
